input.summary: Conform Section 28.1 to New York governing law and remove the conflicting exclusive Singapore forum.
input.comment: [Playbook] We require New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, so we have replaced the Singapore governing law in 28.1 and deleted the Singapore forum, which conflicted with the New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York
